_comment: MV 範本設定。欄位說明見 README.md。範例是〈把青春唱成光〉的前 4 鏡（完整 70 鏡在 examples/）。鏡表從 preview/shots_draft.json（tools/mv_song.py 產生）改起。
title: 歌名

boy.desc: a translucent cherry-red Telecaster-style electric guitar with a white pickguard and a maple neck (no logo on the headstock)

girl.desc: a cherry-sunburst Les Paul-style electric guitar with a cream pickguard (no logo on the headstock)

instrument_note: Guitar orientation (very important): every guitar's HEADSTOCK points toward the RIGHT side of the image (viewer's right), body on the left; the player's LEFT hand is on the neck and the RIGHT hand strums. Never mirrored, never left-handed.
age_note: The children look exactly like their reference photos and keep the same young age (elementary-school kids with childlike faces, never teenagers).
storyboard_cast: Characters (keep consistent across panels): BOY = a 12-year-old Taiwanese boy with a very short buzz cut; GIRL = a 10-year-old girl with shoulder-length hair and bangs.
cine: A cinematic film still from a Taiwanese coming-of-age music video, realistic live-action photograph shot on Kodak Vision3 film with a 50mm lens, natural skin texture, shallow depth of field, subtle film grain, warm amber and soft teal grade. Full-frame image, NO black letterbox bars.
frame_suffix: No text, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no captions anywhere (including guitar headstocks, jerseys and walls). Every hand has exactly five fingers.

h3.style: a realistic cinematic live-action Taiwanese coming-of-age music video, 35mm film grain, natural skin texture
h3.camera: The camera holds a steady shot on a tripod.
constraints: No captions and no readable text appear.
Hands keep exactly five natural fingers; guitar necks and strings stay straight and intact.
No new people walk into the frame.
This is one single continuous shot: no cuts, no scene changes, and no new people, hands or objects enter from the edges of the frame.
h3.soundscape_sing: Only the singing voices of <Audio 1>; no other sound.

boy.name: 男孩
boy.look: a 12-year-old Taiwanese boy with a round face, single-eyelid eyes, slightly tanned skin and a very short black buzz cut, wearing a light-blue and black color-block short-sleeve sports jersey with a large stylized dark bird graphic and no readable lettering, and black athletic shorts
boy.h3_voice: a bright, unbroken boy's singing voice

girl.name: 女孩
girl.look: a 10-year-old Taiwanese girl with a slim oval face, big bright eyes and straight glossy black shoulder-length hair with blunt bangs, wearing a dusty-pink crew-neck sweatshirt with a small white fluffy bunny appliqué, a grey-blue pleated skirt, white knee socks and lavender sneakers
girl.h3_voice: a clear, sweet young girl's singing voice

masters.field: A cinematic wide film still. A Taiwanese elementary school sports field on a sunny day: a red running track with white lane lines around green grass, a big shady banyan tree at one side, a basketball hoop, and a three-story school building with long open corridors in the background. Bright, realistic, no people.
masters.classroom: A cinematic wide film still, shot on Kodak Vision3 film. An empty Taiwanese elementary school classroom on a bright morning: a large green chalkboard with nothing written on it on the front wall, rows of simple wooden desks and chairs (a few pushed aside to open a space at the front), a row of large windows along the LEFT wall with warm sunlight streaming in and soft light beams, a small black guitar amplifier on the floor near the front. Warm amber and soft teal grade, realistic, clean.
masters.rooftop: A cinematic wide film still. The flat concrete rooftop of a Taiwanese elementary school on a clear sunny morning: a waist-high concrete parapet with a metal railing, a small black guitar amplifier with a cable, blue sky with soft clouds, and beyond the railing a generic Taiwanese city skyline of mid-rise apartment blocks and green hills in the distance (no famous landmark, no skyscraper tower). Bright, fresh, realistic.

shots.frame: Wide establishing shot at sunrise: the empty school sports field and the three-story school building, golden morning light, long shadows, a few birds in the sky. No people.
shots.action: Morning light slowly brightens over the empty school field; leaves sway gently in the breeze.
shots.panel: wide establishing shot: empty school sports field at sunrise

shots.frame: Extreme close-up of a boy's right hand strumming a translucent cherry-red Telecaster-style electric guitar with a white pickguard and a maple neck (no logo on the headstock) on a school rooftop in morning sunlight; only the hand, the strings, the pickguard and part of the light-blue and black jersey are visible; his face is out of frame.
shots.action: The right hand strums one bold chord down across the strings and lets it ring; fingers stay natural and five-fingered.
extra_constraints: Only one hand is visible; exactly five fingers; the face stays out of frame.

shots.frame: Medium shot on the sunny school rooftop: the girl from <image1> stands holding a cherry-sunburst Les Paul-style electric guitar with a cream pickguard (no logo on the headstock), fingers on the strings, looking down at the guitar; railing and distant city behind her.
shots.action: The girl plucks the strings, then lifts her head and turns to smile toward someone just off-screen to her right. Her lips stay closed in a smile.

shots.frame: Wide shot on the sunny school rooftop: the boy from <image1> holding a translucent cherry-red Telecaster-style electric guitar with a white pickguard and a maple neck (no logo on the headstock) and the girl from <image2> holding a cherry-sunburst Les Paul-style electric guitar with a cream pickguard (no logo on the headstock) stand side by side, a small amp at their feet with cables, the railing and distant city behind them.
shots.action: Both keeps playing the guitar in rhythm with lips closed, nodding slightly to the beat, then glance at each other and grin.

shots.lyric: 還記得那年第一次進教室
shots.frame: Medium shot in the morning classroom: the boy from <image1> sits on the edge of a wooden desk at the front, holding a translucent cherry-red Telecaster-style electric guitar with a white pickguard and a maple neck (no logo on the headstock), the green blank chalkboard behind him, sunlight from the window on the left; his face and mouth are clearly visible.
shots.action: He sings the lyric with a natural open mouth and expressive face while strumming the guitar in time; his lips follow the song exactly.
